nodes.label: UAC Admin Token Filtering (Access is denied)
nodes.norm_label: uac admin token filtering (access is denied)
nodes.rationale: Windows filters the admin token when a process is launched with explicit alternate credentials, even for Administrators group members.

nodes.label: Built-in Administrator Account Workaround

nodes.label: requireAdministrator Manifest / UAC Elevation
nodes.rationale: Starting, stopping and pausing services requires elevation, so the app requests admin via UAC at launch.

nodes.label: Runtime-Drawn Icons

nodes.norm_label: per-service acl grant via sc sdset (least privilege)

nodes.label: %AppData%\ServiceTrayMonitor\config.json

nodes.label: DPAPI Password Encryption
nodes.rationale: Password is never written to disk in plain text and is only decryptable by the same Windows user account.

nodes.label: Classification rule: defect or change?
nodes.rationale: Behaviour contradicting README/UI/design intent, or losing data, hanging, or leaking is a defect (in SoW); adding/removing/altering functionality, UI, footprint or operating model is a change request.

nodes.label: Integrated change control process (submit-analyse-decide-plan-implement-close)
nodes.rationale: Every change to scope, functionality, footprint or operating model is analysed and decided by the sponsor before implementation.

nodes.label: requireAdministrator manifest elevation
nodes.rationale: Starting, stopping and pausing services requires elevation, so UAC prompts on launch.

nodes.label: Credential save and test flow
nodes.rationale: Test reports success only for a full administrator token AND full SCM access.

nodes.label: Security model
nodes.rationale: Elevated token first; DPAPI entropy in binary is not a secret against same-user processes; credential used in-process via LogonUser, never on a command line or child process.

nodes.label: Service action flow (Start/Stop/Pause/Resume)
nodes.rationale: Action waits for target state (15 s); 'already' counts as success; on Access is denied with saved credential retry via LogonUser batch then interactive plus RunImpersonated.

nodes.label: DEC-002 Keep Admin Credentials; own token first, retry as saved account via LogonUser batch/interactive + impersonation
nodes.norm_label: dec-002 keep admin credentials; own token first, retry as saved account via logonuser batch/interactive + impersonation
nodes.rationale: Own-token-first succeeds whenever the elevated app has rights; fallback covers restricted services; batch logon avoids UAC filtering; in-process impersonation removes pipe deadlock and password-to-child-process exposure. Alternatives: remove credentials, always use credentials, LocalSystem helper service.

nodes.label: LL-01 Test security-sensitive features in the exact elevation scenario
nodes.norm_label: ll-01 test security-sensitive features in the exact elevation scenario
nodes.rationale: Test security-sensitive features in the exact elevation scenario

nodes.label: LL-02 Drain redirected process output concurrently; prefer in-process APIs
nodes.norm_label: ll-02 drain redirected process output concurrently; prefer in-process apis
nodes.rationale: Drain redirected process output concurrently; prefer in-process APIs

nodes.label: Batch logon (not UAC-filtered)
nodes.rationale: Windows does not filter batch logons through UAC, so an Administrators-group account keeps its full admin token; requires 'Log on as a batch job' right.

nodes.label: Own-token-then-saved-credential fallback
nodes.rationale: Actions run with the app's own admin rights first; only if Windows denies access is the action retried as the saved account.

nodes.label: Per-service ACL via sc sdset (least privilege)
nodes.norm_label: per-service acl via sc sdset (least privilege)
nodes.rationale: Grant a dedicated account Start/Stop/Pause/Query rights on specific services so it never needs to be an admin.
